usage: scubiee upgrade [-h] [--pre] [--check] [--no-connect] [--repair]

options:

  --pre         Allow pre-release versions
  --check       Show DiffPlan only (no package swap or migrations)
  --no-connect  Skip MCP/GATE rewrite for enrolled repos
  --repair      Also refresh accel/setup packages after upgrade
  --reindex     Force embedding/index rebuild even if embed ABI unchanged
